Everything is complete. Here's a summary of what was done:

**Changes made:**

- **`src/generator.ts`** — Added Handlebars template engine with `TemplateEngine` class. Loads layouts from `templates/layouts/` and partials from `templates/partials/`. Supports `template` frontmatter field to select a layout. `{{{body}}}` placeholder renders page content. Falls back to inline HTML when no templates available.

- **`src/cli.ts`** — Added `--templates <dir>` option (default `./templates`).

- **`templates/layouts/default.hbs`**, **`post.hbs`** — Default and post layout templates.

- **`templates/partials/header.hbs`**, **`nav.hbs`**, **`footer.hbs`** — Reusable partials.

- **`src/__tests__/generator.test.ts`** — Added 11 template-specific tests. All 12 original tests still pass.

**Key behavior:**
- If `./templates/` exists with `.hbs` layout files, template engine activates
- If no template directory or no layouts, falls back to original inline HTML
- Frontmatter `template: post` selects `layouts/post.hbs`; defaults to `layouts/default.hbs`
- Missing templates gracefully fall back to default or inline HTML
